set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols bfd interface [parameter1].explanation: Enables the BFD protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols ospf area [parameter1].explanation: This command configures an OSPF area in Junos OS, where `[parameter1]` specifies the area ID, enabling OSPF routing within the defined area.

interface [parameter2].explanation: Configure interfaces in the OSPF area.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set ethernet-switching-options storm-con.explanation: This command enables storm control on a specified interface (`[parameter1]`) to limit broadcast, multicast, or unknown unicast traffic to prevent network congestion.

threshold [parameter2] [parameter3].explanation: The command `threshold [parameter2] [parameter3]` sets the threshold values for monitoring or triggering specific actions based on defined metrics or conditions.

resume-threshold [parameter4] [parameter.explanation: The `resume-threshold` command sets the threshold values for resuming normal operation after a high CPU or memory usage event, using `[parameter4]` and `[parameter5]` as percentage limits.

parameters.name: resume-threshold1
parameters.explanation: First threshold for storm control recovery.

parameters.name: resume-threshold2
parameters.explanation: Second threshold for storm control recovery.
